text:
Nick Paul's week has been about someone else. The Leafs Nation reported John Tavares skating in a regular jersey on a line with Paul and William Nylander, with Paul saying he was looking forward to it. If that line sticks, it changes Paul's season.

He needs the help. He has 2 goals on 4.03 expected, and the chances keep coming without going in. The bigger issue is the shot share: Toronto takes just 43% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with Paul on the ice at five on five, and Evolving-Hockey's note from last season says offense isn't his game (bottom 4% of forwards for chance creation).

He's a hard-minutes forward with 33 hits, a penalty-killing profile, and a career built in Ottawa and Tampa Bay before Toronto. Yardbarker also has him saying he'd welcome Nikita Kucherov to Toronto, which tells you how loud that rumor has become. We project about 14 goals. Tavares beside him would be the best thing that could happen to his on-ice numbers. Toronto has lost four of the last five games he's played, so the team needs the jolt too.
headline: Nick Paul waits for Tavares
